title: How to Choose an AI Assistant
subtitle: A practical framework for comparing capabilities, limits and fit.
excerpt: Compare AI assistants by the work you need done, not by hype.

content.text: AI assistants can support writing, research, coding and planning. The best choice depends on your workflow and the level of reliability you need.
Write down three to five recurring tasks. Test each candidate against the same examples so the comparison is useful.
Review plan limits, data controls, export options and regional availability. Verify important outputs independently.
Look beyond the entry price. Consider time saved, collaboration needs, usage limits and whether a free plan is sufficient.

title: A Checklist Before Buying Web Hosting
subtitle: Understand renewal rates, resources, support and backups before committing.
excerpt: A low introductory price is only one part of a hosting decision.

content.text: Hosting plans can look similar while differing in renewal cost, resource limits and support. Compare the terms that matter to your site.
Check introductory and renewal rates, billing period, taxes, add-ons and refund conditions.
Look for storage, bandwidth or visit limits, backup frequency, staging, SSL and migration options.
Consider support hours, channels, response expectations and documentation quality.
